notes.title: Cold Silence receives FREEdom
notes.notes:
Hello, dear players!

This game is pretty old.
First released at 2012 as free game.
Then, with a big update at 2019 on XBOX and here, at Steam.
Next few years Cold Silence received few content updates.

This year, I decide to make this game free.

There are three reasons:
[olist]
[*]Now I'm working on my brand Half-Face Games which will contain only free games.
[*]I believe every game should become free after sell time was over.
[*]I was wrong, selling my games. I make games not for money. But to give players new gaming experience. I'm sure, that "buying game" is a form of supporting developer, who made games you love to play. I don't want to force players support me anymore. If they want, they can donate, for example.
[/olist]

Everyone will be able to play Cold Silence for free starting September 12th.
Maybe free game will attract new players and our community will grew.

notes.title: Creator's Challenge
notes.notes:
[h2]Prepare yourself for the next challenge![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34992487/e10e7b53a1af7779548419a9800bab685a26e2ef.png[/img]

Find the Creator and pass his test to enter secret game mode and get new Achievements!

[h2]Full list of changes:[/h2]
- new game mode, which changes level design and make game much harder
- save system have changes, so if you had any progress it will be lost, sorry
- added Spanish language
- 10 new achievements
- small texts changes
- fixed some bugs, which crash the game
